basis: Audited v1 task admission failed: two tasks completed, two stopped after truncated helper definitions. Gate checks were not run.
changes_before_new_calls: Use the exact function/parameter grammar in the pinned Qwen tokenizer template and native role=tool feedback.
Preserve terminal markers during decoding and remove only the observed native EOS token.
Allow space for a representative legal six-read helper; tokenizer-only tests show that its pretty JSON can exceed the previous 256-token allowance.
Use fresh development identities 24 through 27. Do not rerun or replace v1 outcomes.
Check two benign native function-format requests before any task episodes.
Reject nonfinite logits, preserve the same inert simulator and external stopping rules, and count errors inside compound tools.
Retain fixed task admission before random-direction internal-gate mechanics. Do not tune gate directions or thresholds against outcomes.
limitations: New interface and budget are a combined integration amendment, not an isolated causal test of one parameter.
A virtual helper procedure is not arbitrary host code.
Random gate mechanics do not validate a semantic risk detector or subjective fear.
